message.content: {"issue": true, "summary": "In handleError function, when an error handler throws, the code incorrectly sets reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] to Object.getPrototypeOf(errorHandler) which can lead to infinite recursion or incorrect error handling flow. The assignment should preserve the original error handler chain.", "edits": [{"path": "lib/error-handler.js", "old": "  // In case the error handler throws, we set the next errorHandler so we can error again\n  reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] = Object.getPrototypeOf(errorHandler)", "new": "  // In case the error handler throws, we set the next errorHandler so we can error again\n  reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] = errorHandler"}]}
